svg.title: The same numbers with other primaries
svg.desc: A photograph of a snake shown three times from the same stored values: as sRGB, as intended; read as Display P3; and read as BT.2020, each converted to sRGB for display. Wider primaries make every color more saturated, and some colors fall outside sRGB and are clipped.

g.text: Same numbers read as Display P3
